description: Record an already-issued provider credit note or debit invoice against an existing agency billing line. Platform finance operators only: requires the existing admin key and wildcard scope; agency owner status is insufficient. Verifies exact provider receipt, currency and amount before recording bookkeeping. Creates no invoice, payment or subscription.

amountCents.description: Correction in cents: negative for a credit, positive for a debit; not zero.

providerCreditNoteId.description: Provider credit note ID; required for a credit.

providerDebitInvoiceId.description: Provider invoice ID; required for a debit.

name: agency_billing_record_adjustment
title: Record Billing Adjustment
